AllowedSites.title: Sites the agent may act on
AllowedSites.description: Hostnames (subdomains included). When the list is not empty, every other site is off limits to the agent.

BlockedSites.title: Sites the agent must never act on
BlockedSites.description: Hostnames (subdomains included), added to the built-in blocklist. Users cannot except them.

AllowedPermissionModes.title: Permission modes users may choose
AllowedPermissionModes.description: Any of ask, act, plan. When the list is not empty, the other modes cannot be selected.

DisableExecuteJs.title: Forbid running JavaScript in pages
DisableExecuteJs.description: The execute_js action fails with a policy error.

DisableScheduledTasks.title: Forbid scheduled tasks
DisableScheduledTasks.description: No alarm is created and no scheduled task runs.

DisableUnattendedRuns.title: Scheduled tasks always ask
DisableUnattendedRuns.description: The "run unattended" option on a task is ignored; every scheduled run asks before each action.
